governing_project: KAN-Based Sustainable Fishing Prediction & Decision Support System

catch_tonnes.source: ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute (CMFRI) Annual Marine Fish Landings in India Technical Reports (2012-2024)
catch_tonnes.temporal_resolution: Annual totals & quarterly distributions partitioned to monthly series
catch_tonnes.proxy_method: None (Direct official statistics aligned to CMFRI state landing bulletins)

species_composition.source: CMFRI Fishery Resources Assessment Division (FRAD/FRAEED) species-wise landings

fishing_effort_boat_days.source: CMFRI Marine Fisheries Census (2010/2016/2020) & Kerala Marine Fisheries Statistics
fishing_effort_boat_days.reason_for_proxy: Continuous vessel-by-vessel electronic logbook data is not public for Indian artisanal/mechanized fleets.
fishing_effort_boat_days.proxy_method: District registered active fleet capacity modulated by seasonal operational factors (52-day monsoon ban, post-monsoon surge).

sea_surface_temperature_c.source: NOAA OISST v2.1 via NCEI ERDDAP / Open-Meteo Marine Copernicus Marine Service

rainfall_mm.source: NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) API (MERRA-2 / GPCP)

wind_speed_ms.source: NASA POWER API (10m surface wind speed)

wave_height_m.source: Open-Meteo Marine / ECMWF WAM wave model

chlorophyll_a_mg_m3.source: Derived from Bakun Upwelling Index and coastal precipitation runoff
chlorophyll_a_mg_m3.reason_for_proxy: MODIS/VIIRS ocean color products suffer high cloud obscuration during SW monsoon along Kerala coast.
chlorophyll_a_mg_m3.proxy_method: Coastal upwelling index and precipitation nutrient-flux transfer function.

upwelling_index.source: Bakun Coastal Upwelling Index derived from alongshore wind stress and SST gradients

trolling_telemetry.reason_for_proxy: Real-time vessel GPS trolling lines & lure speed data are not collected by public state statistical departments.
trolling_telemetry.proxy_choice: Trolling suitability index modeled empirically via pelagic tuna/seer presence, wave height constraints, and offshore distance envelope.
